title: Day one.
note: Day one set in Bauhaus pixels, washed in a Japanese gradient and roughed up like a brush.
process: Code only, no generative model. [[Claude Code]] built the letters as square, quarter circle and triangle pixels on a 17 by 25 grid inside a 100 px margin, coloured each from a gradient of five traditional Japanese colours mixed in OKLab, then painted brush strokes and heavy grain over them in [[Canvas]]. The labels are set in [[Google Fonts]], JetBrains Mono and Noto Sans JP.

keywords.did: The only words on the poster, DAY over ONE
